purpose: Sanitized provenance for the two reusable Council PDF design assets. No API token, no signed temporary result URL, no session data, no client data is recorded here.

provider.credential: KIE_API_KEY, resolved by shared-utils/key_resolver.py from the operator secrets store; presence reported as SET, value never read into this record
provider.model_selection: Skill 66 kie-image default route (operator ruling 2026-09-09); explicit request was for the operator default, not a named alternate

request_policy_compliance.prompt_budget_rule: 95-100 percent of the 20000-character live schema max, never below 80 percent
request_policy_compliance.payload_validation: validate -> valid true, errors empty, path /api/v1/jobs/createTask, both jobs
request_policy_compliance.rate_limit: createTask 20 per 10 s; two sequential jobs, no 429 encountered, no retry exercised
request_policy_compliance.prompt_content: art direction only: no body text, no report content, no session data, no client data, no credential material, no reference image, no person

assets.role: reusable interior page frame / page background plate
assets.visual_qc: PASS: double gold rule with mitered corners, four mirrored acanthus corner flourishes with navy accent lines, centre field measurably empty (std 0.61), no text or letterforms, no depicted objects, no photographic texture, no banding; corner ornament verified at 100 percent crop
assets.rights: generated for this project on the operator KIE account; no third-party image, no likeness, no trademark

assets.role: reusable section divider strip, and closing rule when vertically flipped
assets.visual_qc: PASS: centred fleur-de-lis in a gold lozenge with mirrored acanthus scrolls, tapering segmented arms terminated by lozenges, symmetrical margins within 0.03 percent, ground fades to white at the edges, no text or letterforms, medallion crisp at 100 percent
known_minor_differences: ornament vertical mid sits 18 px (1.3 percent of height) above the true midline; invisible at print scale, and the strip is symmetric enough that a software vertical flip produces a matching closing rule
the divider gold reads marginally brighter than the page-frame gold; both sit in the same antique-gold family and are used at different sizes, so the difference does not read as two palettes
assets.rights: generated for this project on the operator KIE account; no third-party image, no likeness, no trademark

preserved_originals.rule: the existing Council hero image and the nine seat portraits are used EXACTLY as they are; no replacement or lookalike was generated, and no original was modified, copied into a new path, or re-encoded

also_checked.note: identical hero bytes; both trees carry the same ten PNGs in assets/seats

baseline_check.checked_by_name_only_not_a_source_of_tru: ~/openclaw-onboarding/version reads 1.0.67 and its working tree has staged changes; it is not the 1.0.72 baseline this run names and was not used as the baseline
baseline_check.print_stylesheet_state_at_1_0_72: runtime/src/reports/render.ts PRINT_CSS still uses 12.5pt body, 13pt h3, and a 9pt @page bottom-center page number, all below the new 14pt floor; the design contract replaces those values

preserved_originals.portrait_manifest_note: assets/portrait-manifest.json declares assets: [] with a note that no portraits or icons have been produced, while nine seat portraits and one cover image exist on disk. The same drift is present in both trees checked (1.0.72 and 1.0.70). This is a registry-versus-files drift in the baseline, observed read-only and NOT changed by this lane. It is reported so the integrator can decide whether the manifest or the directory is authoritative before any asset ships through the manifest gate.

reproducibility.rerun_note: regenerating will produce different pixels and cost credits; these two files are the reusable production set and must be embedded once per template, never regenerated per report
